question: How many countries have higher average generiosity over years compared to the world' average?
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (     SELECT year, AVG(generosity) AS avg_generosity     FROM world_happiness_report     GROUP BY year ) subquery1  JOIN (     SELECT year, AVG(generosity) OVER (ORDER BY year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_generosity     FROM world_happiness_report ) as subquery2 ON subquery1.year = subquery2.year WHERE avg_generosity > running_avg_generosity; This query calculates the average generosity per country for each year. It then compares this with a rolling (running total over time) calculated annualized worldwide averages of generosity, and counts up how many years where it was higher. Note however that as this is an aggregate comparison across countries by their mean value rather than individual values compared to world means directly - the result does not tell us exactly what you are asking for. If we want a count of distinct country-years with above average generosity then it's simpler, and here's how we'd do:  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT year) FROM (     SELECT DISTINCT ON (country_name),year     FROM world_happiness_report      WHERE generosity > (SELECT AVG(generosity) AS avg_generosity                         FROM world_happiness_report as r2                         GROUP BY year) ) subquery1; Note that this query will return the number of distinct years where each country's mean generosiy was above average. If you wanted to find out how many countries ever scored higher in generosity than worldwide averages, then we'd do something like:  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country_name) FROM (     SELECT DISTINCT ON (country_name),year     FROM world_happiness_report      WHERE generosity > ALL((         SELECT AVG(generosity)         FROM world_happiness_report as r2         GROUP BY year))) ) subquery1; Note that 'ALL' in this case will return true only for rows where every row returned from the second query is larger. In a simpler form, we'd do:  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country_name) AS count_countries_with_high_generosity FROM world_happiness_report WHERE generosity > (     SELECT AVG(generosity)     FROM world_happiness_report as r2     GROUP BY year);
